review_method: Assistant read all 40 customer questions, complete order contexts and exact saved replies in four batches; authored criterion judgments before computing this comparison. No reference-answer scores were used. This is not a blinded experiment: prior conversation exposed two local scores and some known failures.
scoring_interpretation: Unsupported currency on nonzero financial amounts is treated as an important unsupported fact: factual correctness=0 and no_hallucination=0, while completeness can remain 2 for otherwise covered requests. Unsupported currency on a zero charge is treated as minor (1/1). Encoding artifacts do not reduce tone when meaning remains clear. Current confirmed status is accepted as not currently marked shipped; cancelled/failed status is not accepted as evidence of shipment history or causation. Address-change refusal and net item-price interpretation are marked ambiguous.

limitations: AI-to-AI agreement is not human-to-judge agreement or ground-truth accuracy.
The rubric does not explicitly fix severity for unsupported currency or ambiguous refusals; these choices affect the average.
